d: Patna Pirates outmaneuvered Gujarat Giants with a stunning 40-27 scoreline in Match 47 of Pro Kabaddi League Season 11. Ayan tested the defence with his impressive 8 raid points, while on the defensive side, Deepak and Shubham Shinde displayed sheer strength, earning 7 tackle points in total with some remarkable tackles. Tune into PKL Season 11 every day from 7:30 PM, only on the Star Sports Network and Disney+ hotstar. Catch all the LIVE updates on prokabaddi.com or the Pro Kabaddi Official App.
